PAHINGI PO NG PANCIT CANTON 🤤

LOOK: Uploader Atty. Vanessa Realizan shared a video of people cooking pancit canton at the back of their vehicle after being stranded for almost four hours along NLEX Valenzuela.

“Filipinos are resilient, but we do not deserve this,” she said in the caption.

Atty. Realizan took the NLEX Connector to avoid flood-prone areas, expecting a 30-minute trip from Manila to Quezon City, but was stuck in heavy traffic for hours. By 10:00 p.m., she saw people cooking due to the long delay.

She added that she finally got home after six hours of travel.

Courtesy: Atty. Vanessa Realizan/TikTok
